title: Quintessentially Gooey Dutch Semolina Casserole
description: A traditional Dutch dish featuring semolina, rest-meat, and a bitter, gooey sauce, this casserole is a nostalgic treat that is also gluten-free friendly. It is perfect for a cold winter night.

ingredients.name: rest-meat
ingredients.notes: such as roast beef or beef shank

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large saucepan, bring the beef broth to a boil.
Slowly whisk in the semolina and reduce heat to medium, cooking until the mixture thickens.
In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat and saute the onion and endive until tender.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked semolina, sauteed onion and endive, rest-meat, gruyere cheese, egg, salt, and black pepper.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and smooth the top.
Bake for 35 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is set.
Remove from the oven and let rest for 10 minutes before serving.
